caption: The drawing depicts a single, elongated object, resembling a vintage wooden thermometer or barometer mounted on a decorative wooden backplate. The backplate is vertically oriented and features intricate, symmetrical scrollwork patterns at the top and bottom, with the wood colored in natural brown tones and accented with shading to suggest dimensionality. At the upper section, there is a small rectangular glass tube—presumably the thermometer or barometer—held in place by metallic clasps, and behind it is a white label marked with measurement increments and partial text, with “RONOMETER” partially visible. The central portion of the object is a rounded, turned wooden shaft that tapers slightly, flanked by more ornate carved elements. Near the bottom, the shaft widens into a circular, layered wooden boss, continuing down to end in matching, detailed woodwork. The overall composition is centered on a plain, light cream background, and the object is rendered in a realistic style with subtle highlights and shadows.
title: Mercury Barometer
